title: feat(gen): submit media jobs asynchronously with owner-scoped results
author: xiaotian1171

gist.summary: Added asynchronous jobs for image, video, audio and 3D generation: send `Prefer: respond-async` to receive a `202` job ID without waiting for generation, then use `GET /v1/jobs/:id` to check pending, succeeded or failed status and `GET /v1/jobs/:id/result` to download the finished file. A cached request can still return the file directly with `200`; the result endpoint returns `409` before success. Only accounts that submitted a job can access its status or result; other accounts receive `404`, and authenticated results use `private, no-store` cache headers. Identical submissions share one generation and one charge, including when submitted by different accounts; polling does not charge again. Completed status records expire after 24 hours. The SDK adds `imageAsync`, `videoAsync`, `audioAsync`, `model3dAsync`, `job` and `jobResult`, with a separate return shape for immediate cache hits. Its media requests now send credentials in Authorization headers rather than URL query strings. API documentation and SDK examples cover the submit, poll and download flow.
